vtrmc-2017-01.prompt: Determine the number of real solutions to the equation $\sqrt{2-x^2}=\sqrt[3]{3-x^3}$.

vtrmc-2017-02.prompt: Evaluate $$\int_0^a\frac{dx}{1+\cos x+\sin x}\qquad\text{for } -\pi/2<a<\pi.$$ Use your answer to show that $$\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{dx}{1+\cos x+\sin x}=\ln2.$$

vtrmc-2017-03.prompt: Let $ABC$ be a triangle and let $P$ be a point in its interior. Suppose $\angle BAP=10^\circ$, $\angle ABP=20^\circ$, $\angle PCA=30^\circ$ and $\angle PAC=40^\circ$. Find $\angle PBC$.

vtrmc-2017-04.prompt: Let $P$ be an interior point of a triangle of area $T$. Through the point $P$, draw lines parallel to the three sides, partitioning the triangle into three triangles and three parallelograms. Let $a$, $b$ and $c$ be the areas of the three triangles. Prove that $\sqrt T=\sqrt a+\sqrt b+\sqrt c$.
vtrmc-2017-04.answer: The three small triangles are similar to the big one, and their sides parallel to one side of the triangle add up (via the parallelograms) to that whole side, so $\sqrt{a/T}+\sqrt{b/T}+\sqrt{c/T}=1$.

vtrmc-2017-05.prompt:
Let $f(x,y)=\dfrac{x+y}{2}$, $g(x,y)=\sqrt{xy}$, $h(x,y)=\dfrac{2xy}{x+y}$, and let
$$S=\{(a,b)\in\mathbb N\times\mathbb N\mid a\ne b\text{ and } f(a,b),\,g(a,b),\,h(a,b)\in\mathbb N\},$$
where $\mathbb N$ denotes the positive integers. Find the minimum of $f$ over $S$.

vtrmc-2017-06.prompt: Let $f(x)\in\mathbb Z[x]$ be a polynomial with integer coefficients such that $f(1)=-1$, $f(4)=2$ and $f(8)=34$. Suppose $n\in\mathbb Z$ is an integer such that $f(n)=n^2-4n-18$. Determine all possible values for $n$.
